meta.name: Grand Oaks at Green Meadows — Phase 1A
caveats: OCH owns 6 lots in this phase — 1 model and 5 specs. All six have surveyed plot plans, so their figures are measured, not derived.
The other 172 lots are shown for context only. Front spot elevations were never extracted for Phase 1A (no grading xref available), so no driveway slope is computed for them.
Pad elevations for all 178 lots were read from the grading sheets and validated 6 of 6 against the surveyed plot plans.
16 lot outlines are drawn slightly under their platted area — shape only, the figures are unaffected.
